## Summary

A short description of what this PR changes and why.

## Motivation

The problem this solves, or the need it addresses. Link the related
issue with `Refs #N` or `Fixes #N` / `Closes #N`.

## Changes

- Bullet list of the concrete changes in this PR.

## Type

Mark the relevant type(s) per Conventional Commits:

- [ ] feat - new feature for the user
- [ ] fix - bug fix
- [ ] docs - documentation only
- [ ] style - formatting, whitespace, no code change
- [ ] refactor - restructuring without behavior change
- [ ] perf - performance improvement
- [ ] test - adding or correcting tests
- [ ] build - build system or dependency changes
- [ ] ci - CI configuration changes
- [ ] chore - routine maintenance

## Verification

Describe how you verified the change. Prefer running the actual
verification commands rather than asserting correctness.

- [ ] `make build` succeeds
- [ ] `make test` (or the project's test command) passes
- [ ] Lint / vet passes
- [ ] Documentation updated for any user-facing change

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and reference the
      issue (`Refs #N` / `Fixes #N` / `Closes #N`).
- [ ] All comments and documentation are in English.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, passwords, or tokens are committed.
- [ ] User-facing docs in `docs/` are updated if behavior changed.
